newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to look higher while above 135.20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to look higher while above 135.20.

text.p: LIFFE September BTPs will remain positive but may trade sideways on Monday before climbing higher, technical analysts said.

"To maintain the break above 135.00 is still the main factor. BTPs continue to look pretty solid and it looks like they will try to extend their gains later on." said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London.
"If it can hold 135.20 then it probably should try to break back above 135.84," he said.
At 0800 GMT, September BTPs at 135.46, down 0.09 on the day.
Celaya said for Monday trading was likely to be flat.
"For today I think we have seen most of the range already," he said.
So far the range has been between 135.75 and 135.43.
He said the contract was well supported and would try to work higher through 135.70, 135.75 and 135.84 later this week and on towards higher levels.
Further out he said BTPs could get to 137.00 over the next few weeks.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London, said the next upside target was 136.00.
"BTPs are relentless. If we can get above 136.00 then the next measured target is 136.65/75," he said. "It is obviously overbought but it doesn't look that keen to go down at the moment."
Wood said so far any retracements on the current rally had been orderly, reaching down to old tops and supports.
To the downside, Wood said there would be no real damage to the contract unless it got back down below 135.35, 135.20.
"That would swing the shorter-term (bias) to the downside and focus 134.84-72 which is a more serious support area," he said.
Celaya also said BTPs would look bearish below 135.20, with further props at 134.80 and 134.70.
"If we can do that then we are set up for a big top and can actually go back down to 132.00," he said, adding that for now that senario looked unlikely.
At the short end, September Eurolira futures were at 93.46, down two basis points from Friday's close.
